rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a boring thing or a person who feels bored, especially when the feeling is dullness or restlessness.

example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 mun6

rows.note: Use this especially when a person is bored or when something seems uninteresting, pointless, or lacking in substance rather than simply sleepy-dull.

example.english: This game is pointless and boring.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau4 hei3 hou2 mou4 liu4
